rules: Human harm is not an institution cost merely because it becomes public.
Training expenditure is not worker repair.
Policy revision is not personal consequence.
Missing public consequence evidence cannot prove that no consequence occurred.
Recurrence must increase accountable burden rather than merely restart training.
